title: serotine.run.v1
description: One JSON object per completed run, one line, JSONL. Normative source: foundry roadmaps/fleet.md § Schema (serotine.run.v1) + fleet telemetry decision. Keys defined by OTel semconv are used verbatim (gen_ai.* per GenAI semconv, host.name per general resource semconv); everything Serotine-specific is namespaced serotine.*. Every run emits a line, LLM or not — non-LLM jobs omit gen_ai.*/serotine.usage and the line is pure heartbeat.

serotine.schema.description: Envelope discriminator. A sibling serotine.event.v1 is reserved for Phase-2 trust-gate ledger events.

serotine.run.id.description: Idempotency key: <label>/<LK_STAMP>-<4 hex>. LK_STAMP is launchd-kit's YYYY-MM-DD_HHMMSS run stamp. Ingest dedupes on it, so spool replay after a failed push is safe.

serotine.job.label.description: launchd job label (or equivalent job identifier on non-launchd hosts).

host.name.description: OTel general resource semconv attribute, verbatim.

serotine.run.start.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with explicit offset (or Z).

serotine.run.end.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with explicit offset (or Z).

serotine.run.exit_code.description: Wrapper exit code; crashed runs still emit (status=fail, real exit code).

serotine.run.status.description: skip = slot-guard/lock short-circuit, emitted so 'skipped by design' is distinguishable from 'silently dead'.

gen_ai.operation.name.description: OTel GenAI semconv operation name (e.g. invoke_agent), verbatim. Present only on LLM runs.

serotine.run.failure.description: OPTIONAL failure forensics: the short, human-readable evidence a wrapper already has in hand when a run dies, so a non-zero exit code is not the only thing the product can say about it. Every member is optional and may be omitted or the whole object left off - a line without it is exactly the line this schema accepted before the field existed. Serotine renders these VERBATIM on an authenticated page: they are operator-supplied text, so the emitting wrapper is responsible for redacting anything secret before attaching it. Serotine bounds EVERY member at DISPLAY time (message 500 chars and last_log_line 1000 keeping their head, stderr_tail 20 lines then 4000 chars keeping its end) and neutralises Unicode bidi controls; there is no length keyword here because this schema's vendored validators implement only the keywords it uses. Bodies must be well-formed UTF-8: POST /api/v1/ingest refuses a malformed byte rather than substituting U+FFFD, because these lines are stored verbatim.

message.description: One line, written for a human: what the wrapper believes went wrong. Must carry at least one non-whitespace character - a blank string would only ever render as an empty box.

last_log_line.description: The final line the run wrote to its own log file, verbatim. Must carry at least one non-whitespace character.

stderr_tail.description: The tail of the run's stderr, newline-separated, oldest line first. Must carry at least one non-whitespace character; leading whitespace on a line is content and is preserved. Keep it to a tail: Serotine truncates for display and the ingest body has a hard ceiling.

serotine.usage.description: One entry per (provider, model) invoked; multi-model runs get one entry each. Omitted entirely on heartbeat-only (non-LLM) runs. Tokens are the source of truth; dollars are derived at ingest.

gen_ai.provider.name.description: OTel GenAI semconv provider name, verbatim (e.g. anthropic; local models use their semconv provider name, e.g. ollama).

serotine.usage.cache_read_tokens.description: serotine.* extension until OTel semconv stabilizes cache-token attributes; migrates to the official names then (same values, renamed keys).

serotine.usage.cache_write_tokens.description: serotine.* extension until OTel semconv stabilizes cache-token attributes.

serotine.usage.cost_usd.description: Advisory only. Ingest recomputes canonically from Serotine's pinned price table and stores both.
